purpose: Fix a deterministic public-contract representation mismatch that causes concrete valid action paths to be rejected by post-model guards that compare only against template-form endpoints.

root_cause_source.interpretation: Two E10e downgrades are attributable to endpoint representation mismatch. The third downgrade is an explicit safe_to_act=false safety block and must remain blocked. Later guards saw already-downgraded outputs and therefore cannot be used to infer their behavior on the original immediate-action proposals.

candidate_change.name: public_tool_contract_endpoint_comparison_canonicalization
requirements: derive all supported action endpoint shapes from research.e2.tool_registry.TOOLS rather than a new hand-maintained endpoint list
map an exact concrete public action path to the equivalent canonical template only in the temporary guard-comparison view
preserve the model-emitted endpoint string in the stored fixed output
reject query strings, fragments, extra text, wrong HTTP methods, and unrecognized endpoint shapes
apply the canonical comparison view before E10d, E10e, E10g, E11, and E13/E14 endpoint decisions
preserve explicit safe_to_act=false as a blocking condition

comparison_anchor.note: E14b is rejected and is diagnostic evidence only; E14c does not inherit the E14b prompt-policy change.

full_remeasurement_condition: Only a complete E14c DEV run that passes every unchanged private-scoring threshold may authorize a measurement-only DEV+VALIDATION rerun. VALIDATION remains forbidden for tuning.
